caption:
Three ways to say sorry

I used to apologize with a but attached. Then I started saying I was wrong and stopping there.

An apology tends to land when it names the thing and stops, and to fall apart when it comes with a but.

For whoever says sorry and stops there.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure, in three labeled scenes. The but: a teal figure says sorry, but... and the blue one narrows its eyes. The pass: a brown figure says sorry you're upset. and the blue one looks down. The plain one: an ink-black figure leans in and says I was wrong., and the blue one's eyes turn happy. The text stays: three kinds of sorry. The last card: Choose friction.
